problem: egress allowlists contain wildcards
planned_decision: match as patterns: * = exactly one DNS label, never ==

problem: event_time stored in 4+ formats (ISO ms, epoch ms, dd/mm/yyyy, ISO without ms)
planned_decision: parse every format to UTC; non-ISO formats get quality flag NONSTANDARD_TIMESTAMP_FORMAT

problem: epoch-ms and dd/mm/yyyy event_times are UTC
detected_by: lateness vs ingest_time ~1 s for every format (no whole-hour offset); day field > 12 proves day-first
planned_decision: interpret as UTC, epoch unit = ms, day-first

problem: unparseable event_time ('not-a-time', impossible date 2026-02-30)
planned_decision: reject MALFORMED_TIMESTAMP

problem: late events (ingest - event > 10 s), up to ~55 min
planned_decision: accept + quality flag LATE (batch has no watermark; Kafka 60 s watermark is M2)

problem: tool.call finished_at is earlier than its start (event_time)
planned_decision: keep row; quality flag FINISHED_BEFORE_START (finished_at is not used by any M1 metric)

problem: duplicate event_id (identical payload, different ingest_time)
planned_decision: keep earliest ingest_time; other copies rejected DUPLICATE_EVENT_ID

problem: unknown agents ag_999 / ag_321 (version 9.9.9)

problem: unknown tenant tn_777 inside otherwise valid sessions

planned_decision: normalise (strip v) + quality flag VERSION_PREFIX_STRIPPED

problem: status null on llm.turn / tool.call

problem: status 'succeeded' is not in the tool-call status enum

problem: negative latency_ms / input_tokens, retry_number = -1
planned_decision: reject INVALID_NUMERIC_RANGE

problem: llm.turn with null output_tokens

planned_decision: keep null (documented nullable)

detected_by: median flow_time - tool.call start = +0.34 s, no hour offset

problem: which version applies inside the sp_research_std v2/v3 overlap
detected_by: audit-log policy_version for research sessions between 2026-01-25 and 2026-02-01 (UTC)
planned_decision: the sandbox itself applied ['3']: newer version wins inside an overlap

problem: truncated lines that do not match the syslog regex
detected_by: anchored regex; length of failing lines
planned_decision: reject UNPARSEABLE_RECORD with raw line + line number

problem: policy_version is '-' (null marker)
planned_decision: null; derive policy_version_applied by validity-window join, flag

problem: exact duplicate lines
planned_decision: keep first, later copies rejected DUPLICATE_EVENT_ID

problem: log_time is host-local with no year and no offset; all hosts are UTC+2, regardless of the eu/us/me hostname
detected_by: socket_connect paired with UTC flows: per-host median offset 1.97-2.03 h, no DST jump; tool-call pairing covers all 42 hosts and agrees with flows within 0.4 s
planned_decision: utc = local(2026) - measured per-host offset (UTC+2 + skew up to ~90 s); fallback -2 h for unseen hosts

problem: detected_at uses a different UTC offset per source_system (+02:00, +03:00, -05:00)
detected_by: offset suffix x source_system crosstab; after UTC conversion 97% of corp-siem / egress-proxy alerts trail their flow by 0-45 s (offsets honest); cloud-ids has no flows to check, offset applied as written
planned_decision: convert with the stated offset to UTC

problem: cloud-ids '*_external' alerts come from source IPs that never appear in flows
detected_by: source_ip membership in flows.src_ip, by rule
planned_decision: leave unmatched (activity outside the platform); never forced

problem: no session_id; correlation needs a tolerance N
detected_by: N-sensitivity table: counts are flat from 45 s to 120 s
planned_decision: rule src_ip=source_ip, dst_ip=destination.host, port, |dt| <= 60 s; report matched/ambiguous/unmatched
